title: Design, synthesis, and anticancer evaluation of new Quinazoline hybrids: DNA intercalation, topoisomerase IIalpha inhibition, and in silico studies.
authors: Hassan, Rasha A; Mahmoud, Zeinab; Elmaaty, Ayman Abo; Elnagar, Mohamed R; Abdou, Amr M; El-Haleem, Akram Hifny Abd; Hamed, Mohammed I A
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成喹唑啉杂合体作为DNA嵌入剂和拓扑异构酶II抑制剂，含分子对接但核心是抗癌药物开发，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法仅常规对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: DNA intercalators and topoisomerases are regarded as prominent targets for cancer treatment. Herein, a novel series of quinazoline hybrids 5-14 were designed and synthesized as potent DNA intercalators and topoisomerase II inhibitors for cancer treatment. Their antiproliferative activity was evaluated in vitro across the NCI-60 human tumor cell lines panel. Compounds 7 and 10 were the most potent and broad-spectrum compounds and were further tested at 5 dose concentrations which showed that compound 7 exhibited robust antiproliferative activity, with submicromolar GI(50) values against several cell lines. Moreover, DNA intercalation of the most prominent compounds 7 and 10 was assessed using the DNA/methyl green assay using doxorubicin as a positive control. It was revealed that compound 7 showed well-established DNA binding affinities with an IC(50) value of 17.19 muM in comparison to the reference drug doxorubicin (11.29 muM). Moreover, topoisomerase IIalpha inhibitory assay of compounds 7 and 10, was conducted using etoposide as a positive control. It was revealed that compound 7 could display an outstanding inhibitory potential against topoisomerase IIalpha with an IC(50) value of 40.51 muM, surpassing etoposide (IC(50) = 66.03 muM). Compounds 7 and 10 induced apoptosis in lung H460 cancer cells with an overall total apoptosis of 39.79 % and 47.17 %, respectively. Moreover, compound 7 significantly increased BAX expression levels to 5.48-fold and reduced Bcl-2 to 0.32-fold, resulting in a striking elevation of the BAX/Bcl-2 ratio to 17.12. Additionally, in silico molecular docking, pharmacokinetic properties, and toxicity features were conducted for all synthesized compounds. It was shown that feasible binding interactions at the target site and eligible pharmacokinetic/toxicity profiles were attained for the investigated compounds. Accordingly, the synthesized compounds can be regarded as promising lead compounds with future optimization for cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: DNA嵌入剂和拓扑异构酶被认为是癌症治疗的重要靶点。本文设计并合成了一系列新型喹唑啉杂合体5-14，作为有效的DNA嵌入剂和拓扑异构酶II抑制剂用于癌症治疗。通过NCI-60人类肿瘤细胞系小组，在体外评估了其抗增殖活性。化合物7和10是最有效且广谱的化合物，并进一步在5个剂量浓度下进行测试，结果显示化合物7表现出强劲的抗增殖活性，对多个细胞系的GI(50)值达到亚微摩尔水平。此外，使用DNA/甲基绿实验，以多柔比星作为阳性对照，评估了最突出的化合物7和10的DNA嵌入能力。结果表明，化合物7显示出良好的DNA结合亲和力，IC(50)值为17.19 μM，而参考药物多柔比星为11.29 μM。同时，以依托泊苷作为阳性对照，对化合物7和10进行了拓扑异构酶IIα抑制实验。结果显示，化合物7对拓扑异构酶IIα表现出卓越的抑制潜力，IC(50)值为40.51 μM，优于依托泊苷（IC(50) = 66.03 μM）。化合物7和10在肺癌H460细胞中诱导凋亡，总凋亡率分别为39.79%和47.17%。此外，化合物7显著将BAX表达水平提高至5.48倍，并将Bcl-2降低至0.32倍，导致BAX/Bcl-2比值显著升高至17.12。另外，对所有合成化合物进行了计算机分子对接、药代动力学性质和毒性特征分析。结果表明，所研究的化合物在靶点位点表现出可行的结合相互作用，并具有合格的药代动力学/毒性特征。因此，这些合成化合物可被视为有前景的先导化合物，未来可进一步优化用于癌症治疗。
